fiveScenarioVerifications.scenarioTitle: Scenario 1: Answer Cites an Expired Policy
fiveScenarioVerifications.expectedGroundTruthOutcome: Cite active policy POL-IT-2026-002 (v2.0, effective 2026-05-01) and active article KB-000032 (v2.0).
fiveScenarioVerifications.actualOperationalRecordObserved: Cited expired policy POL-IT-2026-001 (v1.0, expired 2026-04-30) on ticket submitted 2026-09-03.
fiveScenarioVerifications.actualSystemRemediationOutcome: Retrieval engine excluded expired POL-IT-2026-001 v1.0 and selected active superseding policy POL-IT-2026-002 v2.0 (effective 2026-05-01).
fiveScenarioVerifications.evidenceAndFailureExplanation: Ticket TKT-2026-000003 (submitted 2026-09-03) referenced POL-IT-2026-001 v1.0, which expired prior to submission. VAL-05 and retrieveApplicablePolicyEvidence() detected 100% (200/200) of expired citations and enforced active v2.0 policy citation.

fiveScenarioVerifications.scenarioTitle: Scenario 2: Ticket Routed to an Unauthorized Team
fiveScenarioVerifications.expectedGroundTruthOutcome: Route 'IT' ticket to 'Campus IT Operations & Identity Desk' under rule 'RULE-IT-001'.
fiveScenarioVerifications.actualOperationalRecordObserved: Routed 'IT' ticket to unauthorized team 'Office of Financial Aid & Scholarships' under rule 'RULE-FINAID-001'.
fiveScenarioVerifications.actualSystemRemediationOutcome: validateTicketAssignmentAndRouting() rejected unauthorized team 'Office of Financial Aid & Scholarships' and evaluateTicketRouting() assigned 'Campus IT Operations & Identity Desk' under 'RULE-IT-001'.
fiveScenarioVerifications.evidenceAndFailureExplanation: Assignment ASG-TKT-2026-000007-01 on 'IT' ticket TKT-2026-000007 was routed to 'Office of Financial Aid & Scholarships'. VAL-09 and validateTicketAssignmentAndRouting() flagged all 200/200 unauthorized assignments against RULE-IT-001.

fiveScenarioVerifications.scenarioTitle: Scenario 3: Response Claims an Unsupported Fact
fiveScenarioVerifications.expectedGroundTruthOutcome: Restrict response strictly to facts stated in POL-IT-2026-002 v2.0 (Section 1.2 (Current)).
fiveScenarioVerifications.actualOperationalRecordObserved: Response MSG-TKT-2026-000011-003 asserted an unverified '$5,000 cash grant and 45-day deadline waiver' absent from POL-IT-2026-002.
fiveScenarioVerifications.actualSystemRemediationOutcome: RAG grounding verifier flagged unsupported factual claim (Monetary fees, fines, dollar amounts, or cash reimbursements are not established in the retrieved active policy documents.) and blocked ungrounded assertion, recommending human escalation.
fiveScenarioVerifications.evidenceAndFailureExplanation: Message MSG-TKT-2026-000011-003 on ticket TKT-2026-000011 asserted an unverified '$5,000 cash grant and 45-day deadline waiver' absent from POL-IT-2026-002. VAL-10 and retrieveApplicablePolicyEvidence() detected all 200/200 ungrounded claims with 0 false positives.

fiveScenarioVerifications.scenarioTitle: Scenario 4: SLA Clock Ignores Business Hours
fiveScenarioVerifications.expectedGroundTruthOutcome: Compute elapsed_business_minutes=180m under SCHED-CONFIG-MON-FRI-0800-1700-UTC vs target=240m -> breach_status=false.
fiveScenarioVerifications.actualOperationalRecordObserved: Computed breach_status=true using raw 24x7 wall-clock elapsed=3960m across weekend non-working hours.
fiveScenarioVerifications.actualSystemRemediationOutcome: Business-hour SLA calculator excluded weekend non-working hours (Fri 15:30 -> Mon 09:30 UTC), computing elapsed_business_minutes=180m vs target=240m -> breach_status=false.
fiveScenarioVerifications.evidenceAndFailureExplanation: SLA SLA-TKT-2026-000015 evaluated under wall_clock_24x7 counted 3,960 raw minutes across the weekend and falsely marked breach_status=true. VAL-11 and calculateElapsedBusinessMinutes() detected all 200/200 wall-clock SLA anomalies and verified 180 business minutes elapsed.

fiveScenarioVerifications.expectedGroundTruthOutcome: Transition ticket TKT-2026-000019 to 'escalated' and assign to 'Information Security & Infrastructure Escalation Unit'.
fiveScenarioVerifications.actualOperationalRecordObserved: Ticket TKT-2026-000019 remained assigned to 'Campus IT Operations & Identity Desk' and transitioned directly to 'resolved' without escalation.
fiveScenarioVerifications.actualSystemRemediationOutcome: Escalation engine detected mandatory trigger 'human_review_required' and recommended transition to 'escalated' assigned to 'Information Security & Infrastructure Escalation Unit'.
fiveScenarioVerifications.evidenceAndFailureExplanation: Ticket TKT-2026-000019 had requires_escalation=true (Administrative Escalation Priority) but transitioned directly to 'resolved' without escalation. VAL-07 and evaluateTicketEscalationAndExceptions() detected all 200/200 missed escalations.
